maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from cable carriage affiliate fees, advertising and AMC+ streaming subscriptions for original content, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by cable/satellite distributors, advertisers and streaming subscribers (consumers), not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through original series and streaming brands (AMC+, Acorn TV, Shudder); acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily cancel AMC+ or switch channels; entertainment content is discretionary and substitutable.
